values: Nominated table row showing numeric 30-DAY AVG limits (27,664 lbs/day and 497 mg/L) alongside DAILY MAX entries marked 'Report', each referencing footnote (*10)
Footnote (*8) defining net total dissolved solids as the difference between Outfall 001 discharge and flow-weighted average influent at the two drinking water treatment plants
Footnote (*10) stating that the limits apply from the permit effective date through three years thereafter

grounding.excerpt: Total Dissolved Solids, Net Increase (*8): 30-DAY AVG columns carry numeric limits (27,664 lbs/day and 497 mg/L) with footnote (*10); both DAILY MAX columns read 'Report' with footnote (*10), not numeric values.

Pollutants with enforceable DAILY MAX limits in this table express them as numeric values (e.g., E. Coli DAILY MAX 31.9/235; Cyanide DAILY MAX 1.225 lbs/day and 22 ug/L). The TDS Net Increase (*10) row places 'Report' in DAILY MAX cells while reserving numeric values for 30-DAY AVG only.
*10 The limits begin on the effective date of this permit and lasting through 3 years from the permit effective date.
*8 Net total dissolved solids calculated by taking the difference between Outfall 001 discharge and flow weighted average influent of the two drinking water treatment plants.

rationale: The obligation asks whether DAILY MAX cells marked 'Report' (footnote *10) establish enforceable numeric discharge limits or monitoring/reporting without numeric compliance comparison. The packet grounds a REJECT of the enforceable-limit reading: in the nominated (*10) row, DAILY MAX columns contain the token 'Report', not numeric limits, while the enforceable numeric values (27,664 lbs/day and 497 mg/L) appear only under 30-DAY AVG in the same row. Within the same permit table, parameters subject to numeric DAILY MAX limits are expressed with numbers in those columns; 'Report' is structurally distinct from those entries. Footnote (*10) governs the temporal applicability of 'the limits' but does not supply or convert the DAILY MAX 'Report' cells into numeric limits. Footnote (*8) defines the net-TDS calculation only. Therefore the DAILY MAX 'Report' entries establish monitoring/reporting obligations without an applicable numeric compliance limit in those columns; the numeric limits for this row are confined to the 30-DAY AVG columns.
